target_customer: B2B sales teams at European manufacturers, distributors and wholesalers
problem: Outbound prospecting in Europe is manual and legally risky under GDPR. Venta AI finds companies and decision-makers and runs compliant personalized outreach over email, LinkedIn and letters.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for AI outbound sales platform

founders.name: Lucas Spreiter
education: Technical University of Munich (engineering and IT)
previous_startups: Founded a company building AI systems for enterprises (name not given)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: built race cars, industrial automation and a Hyperloop pod that won the 2017 SpaceX competition.

investors: angels including Gleb Tritus, Julian Borg, Goeran Goering, Freddy Martin

technical_complexity.rationale: Company search over tens of millions of records, contact enrichment, LLM personalization and CRM and ERP integrations are standard engineering with compliance constraints.

defensibility.rationale: EU compliance positioning and German hosting differentiate, but Apollo, Lemlist, Cognism and many AI SDR startups compete.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: AI SDR products multiplied after 2023; specific dated incumbent actions not verified.

market_need_then: European sales teams wanted automated outbound but faced GDPR and competition-law limits that US tools ignored, and LLMs in 2023 made personalized outreach cheap.

branding.domain_note: Uses getventa.ai, a get-prefix domain, not an exact .com.

identity.visual_style: SaaS marketing site stressing Munich and EU hosting
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and confident, European identity, sales teams stay in control

branding.brand_signature: AI revenue platform for Europe, EU compliance positioning

brand_strength.rationale: Venta is Spanish for sale (not stated by sources for this company), shared by many names; European trade press covered the funding only.

pivots.from: Compliant AI colleague for sales teams in Europe, cold outreach by email, LinkedIn and letters
pivots.to: AI outbound and revenue platform for B2B manufacturers, distributors and wholesalers with CRM and ERP integrations and MCP server
pivots.why: Reason not found; current site and YC tagline differ in focus, likely a narrowing rather than a documented pivot

outcome_analysis: Venta AI is active in Munich with named European customers such as ARNO and UnternehmerTUM and vendor-claimed gains of 30 percent more meetings. It raised a $2M pre-seed in July 2025 led by Gradient, two years after YC. Compliance positioning helps in Europe, but the AI SDR space is crowded, so the outcome is open.
notes: Amount conflict: tech.eu says 2M USD, Munich Startup says 1.7M EUR; recorded as 2M USD. Aggregators say the company was formerly Order Link and list 2.5M to 4.0M totals; unverified and not recorded. Legal entity in site footer is april.eleven GmbH. Customer metrics are vendor-reported. No dated 2023 competitor sources found (search returned 2026 vendor guides); list empty. Searches for shutdown or acquisition found nothing. Founding year 2023 per YC, one profile says 2022. Founder prior employers beyond those listed not found.
